description: Cutters with blades ground flat on one side, for trimming a wire or lead close to flush without leaving a sharp stub.
how_to_use: Position the flat side of the jaws against the surface you want the cut to be flush with, then squeeze to trim the lead to length.

plain.what: Small, sharp cutters for snipping wires and extra legs close to the board.
plain.how: Point the flat side towards what you're keeping. Hold the bit you cut off, so it doesn't fly away.
